title: Cosmological Evolution of the Universe in Torsion-based Modified Gravity
summary: General Relativity, despite its century-long success, faces conceptual and observational challenges, including singularities, incompatibility with quantum mechanics, and the need to introduce dark matter and dark energy. Precision cosmology has also revealed persistent tensions, notably the H0 and S8 discrepancies, which question the completeness of the standard Lambda-CDM model. This thesis investigates cosmological applications of teleparallel gravity and its extensions, focusing on f(T) and f(T,T) theories.
